title: Croatian Pork Hash with Nutty Browned Crostini
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the savory flavors of Croatian pork with the nutty crunch of browned crostini.
instructions: Season the pork cubes with salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the hash browns in a separate skillet over medium heat until golden brown.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of hash browns on a plate, top with a few pieces of the cooked pork, and sprinkle with browned crostini.
